exposure: stage of labor at previous cesarean (elective/latent/first/second)
birth weight of newborn at P1 and P2
gestational week of delivery at P2
cohort: 150 parturients at term who underwent IOL at P2 with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation, with a prior CD, between the years 2006 and 2014
finding: The stage of labor at previous cesarean delivery was not associated with successful IOL, while augmentation of labor with oxytocin, epidural analgesia, and birth weight (P2) < 4000 g were.
mod_finding: The stage of labor at previous CD was not found to be associated with successful IOL.
